system.description:
A heavy plasma weapon with devastating effects. This weapon uses an offshoot of nanogram field technology to project a magnetic ‘bubble’ which compresses a mass of plasma into an extremely small space. This bubble is propelled towards the target, collapsing moments before impact, allowing the plasma to expand explosively over a wide area. More akin to a small artillery piece than an infantry weapon, a plasma mortar requires a massive amount of power to operate. Conventional kinetic batteries alone cannot store enough charge.

The profile for the Plasma Mortar can be found in the Military Weapons Table at the start of this section. A Plasma Mortar is a powered weapon, requiring an active power supply (a generator or similar) to operate.
